scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: I thought the timestamps gave us the route. I was wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Ethan wakes when the pump starts. I used to turn it off early.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: The sound before I saw Victor. I thought it was the storm.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: That is not in the log. Show me where you normally switch it off.
